direction: Mature, authoritative British male narrator for a fictional Roman-commander briefing; deliberate educational pacing.

assets.text: You command a flag, not a standing army. Hold provinces to earn points after each turn. Lose all your land? Your home port lets you invade again.
Your three strength cards are one, two and three. Pick one for each attack or defence. Use each once; all three return after every three turns.
On your phone: choose Invade or Guard, then tap a numbered province. Choose your strength card. These numbers are attack strength, not soldiers stored on the map.
Your order is not sent yet. Tap the glowing Confirm order button. When it says Confirmed, your order is safe. You can still edit it before time runs out.
Unguarded land can be taken by any strength. To capture guarded land, beat its strength. Tied strongest attackers change nothing. Now try a practice order.
